sources.snippet: svd-safety-l2_basis_remove40 A Llama-2-7b-chat checkpoint compressed with Basis Sharing (ICLR 2025; shared bases over groups of 2 adjacent layers) to 60.0% of dense parameters, then recovered with a coefficient-only LoRA fine-tune that keeps both the parameter budget and the shared bases exactly.
